$comment: The news synthesiser's own settings. It runs on the same core as the map: same HTTP client, same schema validation, same source isolation, same atomic writes. Nothing here re-fetches anything the map already collects.
$thresholdNote: Similarity was compared against a live batch of ~390 articles. At 0.30 the two Federal Reserve stories stayed apart when they were plainly one event; at 0.22 unrelated pieces began merging. 0.26 held the Iran talks together across five publishers while keeping distinct events separate.
$ageNote: Publishing rhythm differs by role: broadcasters churn hourly, a think tank posts twice a month. One short window silently emptied tier 3.
